description: `client agent-grant --harness claude` fails with `INVALID_ARGUMENT: Unsupported execution harness` and does not say which harness IDs are valid.
expected: The error lists the supported IDs (openai-codex, anthropic-claude-code, cursor), or the help line does.
actual: Only 'Unsupported execution harness'; the help shows `[--harness ID]` with no values.
suggested_fix: Include the allowed harness IDs in the error details and message, and in the help text for --harness.

description: `client list` shows each project's `actorId`, which is the person's own human Actor. The agent's Actor ID is not listed until a grant is made, so an agent reading the output can take the human ID as its own.
expected: The project entry distinguishes the human Actor from enrolled agent Actors (for example `humanActorId` and `agents:[{harnessId, actorId}]`).
actual: A single unlabeled `actorId`; `setupAgent` has a harness but no Actor ID.
suggested_fix: Rename to humanActorId or add the enrolled agent Actors per project in client list.

description: Granting a credential needs the project UUID copied out of JSON. `agent-grant` does not accept the project name, and the browser never shows the project ID or any agent-credential action.
expected: `--project` accepts an unambiguous project name, or the agent profile in the browser offers the grant command with the ID filled in.
actual: UUID only; the agent profile (screenshots/step-5-agent-profile.png) has no ID and no action.
suggested_fix: Resolve --project by exact name when unique; optionally show a copyable grant command in the agent profile.
